Art Block, a purpose-built space for children and families
Autumn 2026 residency on storytelling and world-building

Exhibitions are contemporary art, so suitability varies

places.locationNote: Coordinates from latlong.net (51.474312, -0.069228).

ai.summary: Peckham's eye-catching landmark library on Peckham Square, with a large dedicated children's library that looks deliberately different from the rest. It is busy and well used, and the council runs regular free sessions: dual-language storytelling for under-7s, sensory storytelling and play, crafts and summer activities.
ai.standout: A landmark building with its own children's library and lots of free story sessions
ai.extras: Free; flat access
highlights: Dedicated children's library with views
Dual-language storytelling sessions
Sensory storytelling and play for neurodivergent children
Holiday crafts and summer activities
cautions: Session times change: check the council events listings before going

ArtPlay Pavilion for creative play
Free Sculpture Garden
Seasonal Art Sundays and summer play workshops

ai.summary: A free pedestrian tunnel under the Thames from beside the Cutty Sark to Island Gardens, entered through domed listed rotundas. Walking under the river is a small, memorable adventure,. The lifts have been unreliable, so check their status first.

A full refurbishment has been agreed, which may bring closures

places.name: Old Operating Theatre Museum and Herb Garret
places.locationNote: Coordinates from a Southwark map listing (N51 30.29 W0 05.32); latitude.to gives the same latitude.

ai.summary: A tiny, gruesomely fascinating museum hidden in the roof of St Thomas' Church by London Bridge: an old surgical operating theatre and herb garret. Families describe it as grim but gripping. Best for older children with strong stomachs; a visit takes about 45 minutes.
ai.standout: A real historic operating theatre hidden up a spiral staircase in a church roof
ai.extras: Small entry charge
highlights: Hidden-gem setting in a church attic
Quick visit that pairs with London Bridge or Borough
cautions: Reached by a narrow 52-step spiral staircase: no buggies, not step-free
Gory themes may upset younger children
Opening days vary between listings: check before going
